Determine the pixel dimensions of images in a list

get_image_dimensions.Rd

Takes a list of image objects and calculates their pixel widths and heights via magick::image_info(). Returns a list of c(width, height) numeric vectors.

Usage

get_image_dimensions(images_list)

Arguments

images_list

list of image objects. A list of the images whose dimensions should be calculated, as produced by read_many_images().

Value

list of numeric vectors. A list of length-2 numeric vectors storing the width and height of each image in the input list.
